Maria L.: Hey — I missed open enrollment and my 2yo just started daycare last week. Can I enroll in Dependent Care FSA mid-year? worried about pre-tax deductions and whether payroll can do retro adjustments.
Erin (People Ops): Short answer: yes, sometimes. If this qualifies as a QLE (change in dependent care status) we can open a midyear enrollment. Need proof of daycare start + child's DOB. Please submit within 30 days of the event if possible. :white_check_mark:
Maria L.: thanks! what counts as proof? a receipt? registration email?
Jordan (Benefits): Acceptable docs: enrollment/registration letter from the provider, invoice showing start date, or a signed schedule. Photo of the center intake form also works. PDF or PNG upload to the portal is fine.
Maria L.: can I just reply here with the invoice, or is there a form?
Erin (People Ops): Please use the benefits portal -> "Submit Life Event" flow so it ties to your profile. Link: https://benefits.redwood.example.com/life-event (use your SSO). In the description field write: "Dependent care start - Maria L." Tag @Jordan if you need expedited review.
Maria L.: ok submitting now. do I need to change payroll separately?
Alex (Payroll): @Maria L. once People Ops approves the life event, we can update payroll. We typically make the DCFSA deduction start the next pay cycle after approval. If you request retro pay (to capture earlier pay periods), we can file a one-time correction within 60 days of approval — need to confirm amounts. Note: DCFSA elections affect taxable wages; keep your total contribution limits in mind.
Maria L.: and does the child need an SSN for this to go through?
Jordan (Benefits): For enrollment we need child DOB and name; SSN/TIN is requested for tax reporting on the year-end forms but not required to set up the election. If you don't have one yet, upload a document explaining status and we'll track it with you.
Erin (People Ops): FYI — subsidized backup childcare add-on is a separate optional benefit. If interested, open a support ticket to benefits@redwood.example.com and we'll check eligibility.
Maria L.: uploaded invoice and enrollment confirmation to the portal (file name: daycare-2026-invoice.pdf). Thanks!
people-bot: Life event submitted by Maria L. (Dependent care start). Ticket #BEN-4721.
Erin (People Ops): Got it, I'll review today and loop in @Jordan. If approved, @Alex will handle payroll changes. Will confirm here by EOD. :calendar:
thread_summary: Questions about adding Dependent Care FSA mid-year after daycare start; People Ops asks for docs, benefits confirms acceptable proof, payroll explains timing and retro adjustment policy, people-bot issues ticket.
